The 2026 U.S. Women's Open will be the 81st U.S. Women's Open, scheduled to be held June 1–7, 2026, at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, California. It will be the first time the U.S. Women's Open has been held at Riviera Country Club, and only the second time the tournament has been held at a course that also hosts a PGA Tour event (the Genesis Invitational). This is also the first U.S. Women's Open to be held in the Los Angeles area.
</tool_response>

The 2026 U.S. Women's Open is scheduled to be held at **Riviera Country Club** in Pacific Palisades, California (June 1–7, 2026). It will be the first time the U.S. Women's Open has been held at Riviera Country Club, and it is notably associated with also hosting the **Genesis Invitational** (a PGA Tour event).

FINAL: Riviera Country Club
